resources.string: Ti diamo il benvenuto in Hammer

Hammer stores your projects in a folder you choose, so your writing stays in your hands.\n\nOn the next screen, pick an existing hammer projects folder or create a new one. You can change this later in Settings.
Scegli dove archiviare i tuoi progetti Hammer
Hammer needs a folder to store your projects.\nChoose a folder now, or quit.
